title: refactor(tvp): use capture_outputs for output tracing
body:
Migrated from https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/44110 (original account: @fumadari).

## Summary
- Part of #43979 — refactors `tvp` to use the `capture_outputs`, `can_return_tuple`, and `merge_with_config_defaults` decorators
- Simplifies `TvpAttention` to always return `(output, attention_probs)` (hooks decide what to capture)
- Simplifies `TvpEncodeLayer` and `TvpEncoder` to plain forward without output collection logic
- Adds `_can_record_outputs = {"hidden_states": TvpEncodeLayer, "attentions": TvpAttention}` to `TvpPreTrainedModel`
- Adds `@capture_outputs` to `TvpModel`, `@can_return_tuple` to `TvpForVideoGrounding`
- Net change: 28 added, 101 removed (-73 lines)

## Test plan
- [x] All 82 model tests pass (`pytest tests/models/tvp/ -x -q`)
- [x] `test_capture_outputs_decorator` passes
- [x] `test_hidden_states_output` and `test_attention_outputs` pass
- [x] `test_retain_grad_hidden_states_attentions` passes
